messages:
ashwin: Heads-up — scheduling a rolling maintenance window for APAC1 GPU racks to apply NIC microcode + firmware security fix. Targeting low-traffic night window Apr 2 02:00-06:00 UTC. Affects 12 racks (approx 96 GPUs).

maria: ETA on per-rack drain time?

ashwin: ~20-30m rack drain + firmware flash + reboot + post-checks. Plan is staggered 1 rack every 25m, 12 racks -> ~5.5h but we'll parallelize 2 racks where we have spare capacity.

liam: What's the customer impact? Dedicated tenants on those racks?

ashwin: Minimal. Most capacity is on shared-hosted pool. We'll avoid racks pinned to reserved contracts. For any Dedicated tenants on impacted racks we've already opened tickets and proposed live migration or an SLA waiver.

maria: We should pre-warm burst capacity in US/EU to absorb traffic if we see elevated cross-region failover. Cost-wise ballpark?

liam: Pre-warm + 3h cross-region traffic bump ~= ~$2k-3k. Confirm with finance?

ashwin: yep — sent quick estimate to @eva for approval.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Runbook created: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/apac1-nic-fix (private)

ashwin: Runbook highlights: 1) cordon+drain nodes 2) flash microcode via vendor-tool 3) reboot + nvlink health check 4) run perf smoke tests, revert if errors.

maria: Add exact drain commands for kube + runtime processes into runbook. small snippet in case people need it:

maria: ```
kubectl cordon node-01
kubectl drain node-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=30m
# runtime: stop-serving node-01 && wait for KV cache to drain
```

ashwin: Good call — added. Also included a fallback to move hot routes to eu-west if latency > 300ms for >5min.

eva: Approved the burst budget. Please tag finance:costs for the chargeback.

liam: Who's on pager for the window? I can take first 2h then eva can take next. @maria can you be on standby for rollbacks?

maria: I can standby for rollback & perf verification.

ashwin: Assigning: liam (02:00-04:00 UTC), eva (04:00-06:00 UTC), maria standby. I'll run orchestration and watch pre/post metrics.

infra-bot: incident-bot: created incident INC-APAC1-2026-04-02 for maintenance window (low-severity planned).

ashwin: Pre-check checklist for tomorrow:
- confirm all telemetry alerts disabled for maintenance
- snapshot KV caches where applicable
- notify Dedicated customers again 24h prior
- ensure kernel logs collection enabled

liam: Will add an automated alert to #incidents if more than 10% pod eviction rate or >200ms p99 latency.

maria: After each rack, capture perf metrics and paste short summary in this thread: p50/p95/p99 latency, token/sec, errors. If degradation >5% at p95 we pause and investigate.

ashwin: Agreed. We'll also run a synthetic prompt set (10 queries) via /internal/bench to sanity check quality.

eva: One more ask: update status page with expected window + contact. I'll publish once you confirm wording.

ashwin: Draft status update: "Planned maintenance in APAC1 for firmware security updates on GPU racks. Expect rolling reboots Apr 2 02:00-06:00 UTC. Minimal impact; we have cross-region capacity and dedicated tenants notified. Follow @redwood-status for live updates." Any edits?

liam: LGTM. Add note about "may cause increased latency for APAC traffic for short periods".

ashwin: Done. Final: post at T-24h and again 10m before start.

infra-bot: reminder-bot: scheduled message will post to #status at 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z and 2026-04-02T01:50:00Z.

maria: Ok ready. I'll be on standby in #eng-infra during window.

liam: I'll take the first handoff and post rack summaries.

eva: Thanks everyone. Please keep comms concise during the window — only critical updates to status channel. :white_check_mark:

ashwin: Thanks team. I'll kick this off and paste the rack sequence 30m before start. :rocket:
